In a human study, Coffey and colleagues (17) investigated the effects of multiple sets of maximal isokinetic knee extensions in well-trained cyclists versus competitive pow- erlifters. Post-exercise biopsy results showed that AMPK was significantly elevated in the aerobic endurance-trained subjects, but not the strength-trained subjects. Moreover, p70 S6K and S6 ribosomal protein phosphorylation was markedly elevated in the aerobic endurance-trained subjects, but not strength-trained subjects.
